name: media-modal
blurb: Image or video expands to fullscreen with backdrop blur and smooth zoom.
description: A clickable image or video container that animates to fill the viewport on activation. Uses layout animation (Framer Motion) to morph the trigger into a centered fullscreen modal. Supports both static images and looping videos with controls.
use_when: You want to let users zoom into photos or watch videos without leaving the page.
avoid_when: You need a pre-sized container — this responds to its parent and collapses without one.
a11y: Escape key closes. Backdrop click closes. ARIA label on close button for videos. No focus management beyond that.
